title: FORGET.SCOPE Request
description: Scope erasure / offboarding request (protocol v0.5.0, spec §10). Owner-only: FORGET.SCOPE is an owner decision and is NEVER a staff capability (§10b.2). Targets client scopes only — self/workspace are pod-internal and rejected by the handler.

scope.description: The client scope boundary, e.g. `client:acme#1`. Scope ids are non-reusable versioned markers: `#1` is permanently retired on erasure (§10b.1).

reason.description: reason DETERMINES behavior: erasure = physical content purge across every lane (L0/L1/L2/L3 + vector + compile queue + fingerprint) with zero-result conformance; offboarding = tombstone + grant revoke, auditably REVIVE-able, scope entry retained.

actor_id.description: Owner actor (`user:<slug>` per spec §10b.1). The handler requires the requesting actor to BE the config owner; staff never invoke this operation.

owner_pointer.description: Optional owner-approved NON-PII pointer (e.g. "client since 2023, 4 jobs, no disputes") carried into the next `client:<id>#n` marker. Valid ONLY for reason=offboarding — an audited choice, never a silent resurrection.
